scope_notes: Mentor v3.7 owns long-run S0/B0, candidate universes, client constraints and project state; it does not decide current-run per-asset deployment sizes.

V70_2.html Output Contract v1.1.1 is the executable tactical small-knob source: it receives S0/B0, computes macro-driven C and T, and outputs only total equity, total bond and V70_ORIGINAL_DRY_POWDER budgets plus run/life-stage metadata. It must not select individual stocks or bonds.
BondV75 v2.5 owns the formal bond execution map: life-stage US/Taiwan bond-sub-bucket targets, US SGOV/SPSB 70/30, Taiwan 00859B/00860B 80/20, and the market-safety/deployment decision.
BNDW is removed from generic new-allocation candidates as of 2026-09-15. Existing BNDW remains manageable under BondV75 as an existing holding; historical snapshots are not rewritten.
Mentor v3.7 forbids attributing SGOV 70% or other per-bond current-run weights to Mentor. Fixed long-run bond target maps belong to BondV75, not Mentor or V70.
SGOV_BOND_BUCKET and SGOV_DRY_POWDER_BUCKET share ticker SGOV but are separate accounting roles and must never be double-counted.
Candidate examples are a generic research starting universe, not mandatory holdings. Client-specific preferred/existing assets require a separate client snapshot when backtested.
